baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual links فضل الله and رحمته directly to the unrealized لمس of عذاب عظيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Favor as an unowed gift and mercy as tender care form a protective interval between culpable conduct and the severe consequence that would otherwise reach its agents.

activation_trace.role: An unowed benefaction supplies the surplus intervention that interrupts strict consequence.
Tender care gives the interruption a preservative rather than merely procedural character.
An effect reaching and afflicting its object marks the consequence that grace prevents.
Severe penal pain identifies the withheld consequence.
A grave descending calamity gives the threatened consequence exceptional weight.

changed_reading.before: Favor and mercy simply cancel an otherwise deserved punishment.
changed_reading.after: Favor and mercy are an extra, preservative buffer that keeps the deed's punitive effect from making contact with its agents.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَفَضْتُمْ and the enclosing construction فِي مَا أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speech event is both an outward current and an environment entered collectively: talk spills beyond a source, spreads, and surrounds its participants until its consequence can flow back toward them.

activation_trace.role: Expansive talk and a disclosed report make the conduct a spreading discourse rather than a private thought.
Easy abundant flow supplies the material logic by which many utterances become one current.
The current's social action is completed when its harmful effect reaches those carried in it.

changed_reading.before: The verse threatens punishment for something the group discussed.
changed_reading.after: The verse threatens the participants in a discourse current they collectively released and inhabited, with harm poised to return downstream.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ stands before the counterfactual لَمَسَّكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The near or first horizon and the later horizon form one extended field of consequence; mercy is not a momentary reprieve but protection across immediate and deferred reach.

activation_trace.role: The near or first domain supplies the immediate horizon of possible consequence.
What comes after supplies the deferred horizon paired with the near one.
Reaching contact unifies the two horizons as possible arrival points of one consequence.

changed_reading.before: Divine mercy is available in this world and the afterlife.
changed_reading.after: The pair maps a continuous causal span: consequence can arrive near or later, while mercy blocks its reach across both horizons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah decomposes the overflow into a relay: an item is received through one speaking organ and immediately emitted as socially circulating speech, with knowledge absent from the transfer.

activation_trace.role: Spreading discourse is the focus mechanism that the next ayah resolves into individual transfers.
Receiving and taking up speech supplies the intake stage of the relay.
The tongue is the speech organ that turns each receiver into a new transmitting node.
Speech circulating among people supplies the network-level spread produced by repeated utterance.

structural_cues: 24:15 orders reception by tongues, saying by mouths, absence of knowledge, and the contrast between humanly easy and divinely great.
The same pronominal object passes from reception to utterance without an intervening verification step.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uptake, organs of speech, public circulation, and absent knowledge; I infer an intake-to-output arrow in which each hearer becomes a transmitter. A live alternative is simultaneous collective immersion rather than a serial relay.

changed_reading.before: أَفَضْتُمْ denotes abundant or prolonged collective discussion.
changed_reading.after: أَفَضْتُمْ denotes a mouth-to-mouth relay in which receiving becomes retransmission and liability attaches to circulation without knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The discourse current becomes a self-propagating social path: diffusion scatters the content, repeated followers reinforce its track, and favor and mercy answer the spread with purification rather than merely shielding speakers from penalty.

activation_trace.role: The focus speech-flow supplies the process that later spreading and following specify.
Diffusion and dispersal turn repeated speech into a community-wide propagation event.
Following trace after trace supplies the recursive adoption that keeps the process moving.
A visible path of successive steps models how prior participation makes later participation easier.
Purification supplies the counterprocess by which favor and mercy remove the spread's contamination.

structural_cues: 24:19 couples desired social spread with punishment in the same two horizons named in 24:14.
24:21 repeats فضل الله and رحمته inside a warning against following successive steps, then names purification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diffusion, tracked following, and purification under the repeated grace formula; I infer that rumor propagation is one instance of the stepwise contaminating process grace can interrupt. The steps can also denote a broader course of misconduct, so the identification is not exclusive.

changed_reading.before: The overflow is a one-time conversational excess from whose punishment the group is reprieved.
changed_reading.after: The overflow is a recursive social contamination: each repetition extends a path for the next, while favor and mercy operate as the purifying interruption.

context_deltas.mechanism: The threatened touch closes an evidentiary loop: unsupported speech creates liability, the organ that circulated it later bears witness, and the account is delivered without deficit.

activation_trace.role: Harmful effect reaching the body supplies the endpoint of the evidentiary sequence.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the legal standard that the circulating claim lacks.
The tongue as witness turns the former transmission organ into an evidentiary organ.
The bodily speech organ preserves continuity between utterance and later testimony.
Full delivery without deficiency makes punishment the exact settlement of accumulated liability.
Accounting and recompense identify the juridical form of that settlement.

structural_cues: 24:13 demands four witnesses and classifies the unsupported accusers as liars before God.
24:24-25 moves from bodily testimony to full payment of the true account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the witness threshold, the later testimony of the tongue, and complete settlement; I infer that the same body that relayed the report carries its evidence into judgment. The bodily testimony may cover all deeds rather than this speech alone.

changed_reading.before: Punishment would simply afflict the people because they spoke wrongly.
changed_reading.after: Punitive touch is the endpoint of an embodied accounting loop: speech deposits liability in the speaking body, whose tongue later testifies when the account is settled in full.

context_deltas.mechanism: Grace becomes reproducible social action: material breadth continues to flow toward vulnerable relations, pardon erases the punitive trace, turning aside declines retaliation, and forgiveness shields the offender from the deed's effect.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction shifts favor from a divine exception alone to a human capacity for continued giving.
Breadth of means supplies the resource channel through which favor remains socially available.
Erasure of an effect models refusal to keep the injury active in later relations.
Turning aside beautifully from the offense interrupts retaliatory fixation.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer from its effect completes the counterflow.

structural_cues: 24:20 repeats the فضل and رحمة counterfactual after the warning about social spread.
24:21 links that formula to purification, and 24:22 immediately places فضل in human hands before commands to pardon and turn aside.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated divine favor, human favor and breadth, pardon, turning aside, and sought forgiveness; I infer a downward-to-horizontal arrow in which received mercy becomes enacted mercy. The later commands may describe aftermath ethics without defining the earlier counterfactual.

changed_reading.before: Grace is a vertical exemption that prevents divine punishment.
changed_reading.after: Grace is also a horizontal counterflow: continued giving, erasure, and pardon keep rumor injury from cycling into retaliatory deprivation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later cloud sequence supplies a process model for the focus current: small units are driven, joined, heaped, released as precipitation, aimed toward recipients, and finally either allowed to strike or turned away.

activation_trace.role: Easy abundant flow anchors the speech event to the later fluid process without replacing its discursive sense.
Gentle driving supplies the initially low-force movement of separate units.
Joining one thing to another supplies the aggregation step.
Layered accumulation supplies the threshold at which scattered units become a consequential mass.
Descending rain supplies the release of the accumulated current toward recipients.
Hitting an intended target supplies the impact corresponding to threatened punitive contact.
Turning impact away supplies a natural analogue for the protective action of favor and mercy.

structural_cues: 24:43 presents driving, joining, heaping, precipitation, striking, and diversion in that order.
24:14 likewise orders human flow, counterfactual protection, and an impact that otherwise would have reached the participants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the full meteorological sequence; I map its aggregation-to-impact arrow onto discourse and assign diversion the functional place occupied by favor and mercy. The weather passage remains an independent sign, so this is a cross-domain mechanism rather than a lexical gloss.

changed_reading.before: The group spoke expansively and was spared the resulting punishment.
changed_reading.after: The event reads like diverted precipitation: utterances are driven together and accumulated until consequence could fall and strike, while favor and mercy redirect the impact.

context_deltas.mechanism: A distant branch of عذاب as restraint or weaning combines with the immediate admonition against return: threatened punishment would forcibly stop a recirculating habit, while merciful warning enables voluntary cessation before pain is required.

activation_trace.role: Restraint and weaning supply a corrective function beneath the ordinary penal sense.
Circulating talk supplies the habit from which participants must be detached.
Fear-bearing reminder supplies a nonpunitive means of softening the heart and stopping recurrence.
Return after stopping supplies the recurrence that the warning is designed to prevent.

structural_cues: 24:17 follows the exposure of the speech relay with admonition never to return to its like.
The focus counterfactual makes mercy logically prior to the punishment that otherwise would make contact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a restraint branch, a spreading speech event, warning, and prohibited return; I infer that mercy substitutes educative self-withdrawal for coercive interruption. The dominant عذاب branch remains penal pain, so restraint is a secondary exploratory function.

changed_reading.before: Punishment would inflict pain in response to the speech.
changed_reading.after: Punishment also shadows the speech as forced weaning from a recurrent habit, while mercy offers admonition as the gentler way to stop its return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the same root moves from afflictive contact in 24:14 to literal fire contact in 24:35. It remains anchored by the exact م س س recurrence and two counterfactual negations, but downstream prose should present an activation-threshold analogy, not claim that punishment is fire or that the two uses are synonymous.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَمَسَّكُمْ is activated by the later لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ.

activation_trace.role: Afflictive contact supplies the unrealized threshold in the focus ayah.
Literal contact supplies a contrasting threshold between latent capacity and external ignition.
Ignition gives contact a concrete activation function.
Light appearing near the contact threshold shows an effect poised before full external activation.

changed_reading.before: Touch is only an idiom meaning that punishment would afflict them.
changed_reading.after: Touch marks an actualization threshold: favor and mercy keep punitive potential from crossing into experienced impact, in contrast with oil poised to shine before fire contacts it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps domestic access rules onto discourse. It remains anchored in the repeated enclosure فِي ... فِيهِ and the flow sense of أفضتم, then gains a whole-surah threshold mechanism from entry, permission, and return; render it as a spatial-social analogy, not as a claim that the focus construction literally means entering a house.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled enclosure in فِي مَا أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ allows the speech current to be read as a social interior crossed by its participants.

activation_trace.role: Spreading discourse supplies the informational domain whose boundaries are crossed.
Movement into an interior supplies the spatial analogue for entering another's protected affairs.
A sheltered dwelling supplies the model of a socially bounded interior.
Permission supplies the missing threshold condition for legitimate entry.
Turning back supplies the proper response when access to the interior is not granted.

changed_reading.before: The group entered deeply into a topic and spread talk about it.
changed_reading.after: Their overflow is also an unauthorized crossing into a protected social interior; mercy withholds impact where they failed to stop and turn back at an informational threshold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports the later sea image into a speech verb. It remains valid as a material analogy through the focus root's fluid branches, the repeated فِيهِ, and the whole-surah sequence of deep water, overlapping waves, and obscured sight; qualify it as a model of epistemic immersion rather than a lexical meaning of أفضتم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فِي مَا أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ can describe not only releasing a current but being inside the current released.

activation_trace.role: Abundant easy flow supplies the fluid substrate of the immersion model.
Vast water supplies an environment large enough to engulf rather than merely carry the participants.
Persistent plunging or obstinacy supplies the self-reinforcing depth of participation.
Overlapping turbulence supplies repeated utterances that interfere with and amplify one another.
A covering layer supplies the loss of epistemic visibility produced by accumulated repetition.

changed_reading.before: The speakers broadcast a report outward.
changed_reading.after: They also submerged themselves in layered, mutually reinforcing discourse whose turbulence made knowledge harder to see even as circulation increased.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant reading: it activates reproductive branches of رحمة and عذاب alongside the fullness branch of فيض. All three anchors occur in the focus ayah and yield a coherent containment-versus-discharge mechanism, but syntax does not require it; downstream prose should label it a material exploratory image and never replace the ordinary mercy and punishment senses with it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَحْمَتُهُ, أَفَضْتُمْ, and عَذَابٌ carry branch images of enclosure, swelling fullness, and post-birth discharge.

activation_trace.role: A womb as protective container supplies the image of mercy holding a dangerous process within bounds.
Expansion from fullness supplies the swelling pressure generated by collective speech.
Post-birth discharge supplies the threatened release of what the containing mercy has prevented from emerging destructively.

changed_reading.before: Mercy externally spares speakers from a penalty after their discourse.
changed_reading.after: Mercy can be pictured as gestational containment of a swelling social crisis, preventing its punitive aftermath from being delivered as a destructive discharge.

strongest_changes: أَفَضْتُمْ shifted from generic collective discussion to a resolvable intake-to-output relay and then to recursive social diffusion.
لَمَسَّكُمْ became the endpoint of embodied evidentiary accounting rather than an undifferentiated threat.
فضل and رحمة became a social counterflow of giving, erasure, and pardon, while the cloud sequence exposed an aggregation-to-impact process that can be diverted.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly re-expressed the focus mechanics in different domains: legal witnessing, bodily speech, purification, pardon, protected interiors, light without contact, layered water, and driven precipitation. Keeping those domains separate preserved several changed readings that a single thematic summary would collapse.
remaining_uncertainties: The light, privacy, sea, and cloud correspondences may be deliberate sequence-level activations or reader-supplied material analogies.
The restraint branch of عذاب and the gestational containment model remain productive but form-distant.
The الدنيا والآخرة pair may mark two distinct arenas rather than one continuous causal horizon.
